A.criteria: Every month averages 18 °C or higher, so there is no true winter (tropical group).

B.criteria: Annual precipitation falls below an aridity threshold set by mean annual temperature and rainfall seasonality (arid group).

C.criteria: Coldest month averages 0–18 °C (some sources use −3 °C), warmest month above 10 °C (temperate group).

D.criteria: Coldest month averages below 0 °C (or −3 °C) while warmest month still averages above 10 °C (continental group).

E.criteria: No month averages above 10 °C, too cold for tree growth (polar group).

Af.criteria: Every month at least 18 °C and every month at least 60 mm precipitation; no dry season.

Am.criteria: Every month above 18 °C; short dry season where driest month is under 60 mm but above 100 minus (annual mm/25).

Aw.criteria: Every month above 18 °C; driest month under 60 mm and below 100 minus (annual mm/25), dry season in low-sun winter.

BWh.criteria: Annual precipitation below half the aridity threshold; mean annual temperature 18 °C or above.

BWk.criteria: Annual precipitation below half the aridity threshold; mean annual temperature under 18 °C.

BSh.criteria: Precipitation between 50% and 100% of the aridity threshold; mean annual temperature 18 °C or above.

BSk.criteria: Precipitation between 50% and 100% of the aridity threshold; mean annual temperature under 18 °C.

Csa.criteria: Coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, dry summer (driest summer month under 40 mm, wettest winter month at least 3x driest summer month).

Csb.criteria: Coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month below 22 °C with 4+ months above 10 °C, same dry-summer rule as Csa.

Cfa.criteria: Coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, no significant dry season.

Cfb.criteria: Coldest month 0–18 °C, warmest month below 22 °C with 4+ months above 10 °C, no dry season.

Dfa.criteria: Coldest month below 0 °C, warmest month above 22 °C, no significant dry season.

Dfb.criteria: Coldest month below 0 °C, warmest month below 22 °C with 4+ months above 10 °C, no dry season.

Dfc.criteria: Coldest month below 0 °C, only 1–3 months above 10 °C, coldest month above −38 °C, no dry season.

examples: High Andes/Himalaya above the tree line

EF.criteria: Every month averages below 0 °C; permanent ice, never thaws.

second.m: monsoon (short dry season, doesn't meet w/s criteria)

third.b: warm summer (warmest month below 22 °C, but 4+ months above 10 °C)
third.d: very cold winter (coldest month below -38 °C; D group only)
third.h: hot arid (mean annual temperature 18 °C or above; B group only)
third.k: cold arid (mean annual temperature below 18 °C; B group only)
